corrections_applied: See contracts/CHANGELOG.md and docs/pathways/DECISION_LOG.md Section K (Phase 3E) for the full calibration rationale: parent-facing wording, positive framing, question-option changes, adaptive branching, normalization, and legacy compatibility. Phase 0 corrections (DEC-C1) are preserved verbatim below; Phase 3E only rewords/re-enumerates, it never removes a canonical question. Source pack version: 1.0.0-candidate (preserved verbatim at docs/pathways/pack/contracts/question-bank.json). Prior version: 1.1.0-phase0-corrected.

questions.parent_wording: What should we call your student? A first name or nickname is fine.
questions.matching_use: Optional presentation only. Never affects fit. Maximum 40 characters; fallback: your student. Never scoring evidence, never AI/recommendation input (Phase 3E owner decision, unchanged).

questions.parent_wording: What grade is your student currently in?
questions.helper_text: This helps us ask the questions that are most relevant right now.
questions.matching_use: K-4 ELEMENTARY; 5-8 MIDDLE; 9-12 HIGH_SCHOOL; other/unknown UNDETERMINED. Do not infer grade from age. The sole authority for grade_band.

questions.parent_wording: How old is your student?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: no longer shown universally -- only when age context is genuinely useful (current_grade OTHER/UNKNOWN, or grade-placement/reclassification planning is active via DISC_006's GRADE_PLANNING reason). Optional age in years, not date of birth. No automatic eligibility, placement, acceleration, or retention decision. Under-5 or adult entries receive neutral advisor review.

questions.parent_wording: Where is your student currently based?
questions.helper_text: Education options can vary by state. This helps us keep future pathways relevant to where you live.
questions.matching_use: State: US states and DC plus US_TERRITORY, OUTSIDE_US, UNKNOWN. ZIP optional string, never numeric. No browser geolocation. Do not infer legal residency, local eligibility, location permission, or service/provider availability. State-only does not block generic Discovery.

questions.parent_wording: How is your student learning today?
questions.helper_text: There's no right answer -- we just want to understand your starting point.
questions.matching_use: Starting context only. UNKNOWN is not NOT_ENROLLED. No automatic school-change conclusion.

questions.parent_wording: What brought you to Pathways?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: parent-facing labels reworked to positive/outcome language (see labels.ts); canonical values unchanged except CURRENT_SCHOOL_CONCERN/DIFFERENT_ENVIRONMENT/ENVIRONMENT_CONCERN retired from new-entry use and replaced by one canonical BETTER_FIT_ENVIRONMENT (SMALLER_ENVIRONMENT stays separate). Legacy values remain valid historical answers and normalize to BETTER_FIT_ENVIRONMENT for current/effective evaluation only (contracts/legacy-aliases.json question_value_aliases); raw historical records are never rewritten. K-4 hides COLLEGE_ADVANCEMENT, CREDIT_RECOVERY, GRADE_PLANNING. EXPLORING exclusive. OTHER needs no mandatory narrative.

questions.parent_wording: If we could help you make progress on one thing first, which would matter most?
questions.matching_use: Values restricted to current DISC_006 choices. Auto-derive if exactly one choice. No hidden default.

questions.parent_wording: What would you most like your student's education to provide?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reworded and simplified; OUTSIDE_OPPORTUNITIES retired from new-entry use (question_value_removals) in favor of a plain OTHER card -- no inline text on this single-choice question, per Phase 3F section 2's list of the five multi-select fields that get inline Other elaboration (this is not one of them). K-4 still hides COLLEGE_COURSES.

questions.parent_wording: How is your student's learning going now?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: wording shortened; Phase 3E's positive labels (AHEAD/ON_LEVEL/MIXED/STRUGGLING/SIGNIFICANT_CONCERNS/UNKNOWN) are unchanged.

questions.parent_wording: Where would you need the most support?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reworded, helper sentence removed, max 3 selections added (wording now says "most support"). Consolidated ROUTINES/ORGANIZATION/TIME_MANAGEMENT/TASK_COMPLETION/STUDY_SKILLS into new canonical ORGANIZATION_STUDY_HABITS, and ENGAGEMENT/CONFIDENCE into new canonical ENGAGEMENT_CONFIDENCE, both aliased from every legacy value in contracts/legacy-aliases.json. PHONICS retired from this universal screen -- still available via DISC_E01's elementary foundational follow-up. MISSING_CREDITS ("Credits or graduation") grade-tiered to HIGH_SCHOOL/UNDETERMINED only. Added OTHER with inline free-text elaboration.

questions.parent_wording: How does your student work best?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reworded to a simpler 5-answer set; INDEPENDENT_WORK_DIFFICULT retired from new-entry use and aliased to CLOSE_ADULT_SUPPORT (semantically compatible -- both represent a need for closer support) in contracts/legacy-aliases.json, so support_structure_need's HIGH-tier signal is preserved for historical answers. DISC_012 (preferred_learning_environment) now precedes this question in evaluation/display order (Phase 3F section 9); this question stays show_when ALL (broadly active) rather than a DISC_012-gated follow-up, since most DISC_012 answers (LIVE_TEACHER/HANDS_ON/SMALL_GROUP/ONE_TO_ONE/MOVEMENT) would otherwise lose their only support_structure_need signal -- see docs/pathways/DISCOVERY_UX_SIMPLIFICATION_PHASE3F.md.

questions.parent_wording: How does your student learn best?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reworded and moved to precede learning_support_pattern in evaluation/display order (the new "contextual lead question" for the Learning section). Added a plain OTHER card with no inline text (judged unnecessary complexity for this question, per Phase 3F section 8's explicit discretion) -- BOOKS/TECHNOLOGY remain retired from new-entry use.

questions.parent_wording: How much flexibility would be helpful?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Scheduling preference does not establish any provider capability. Feeds derived schedule_flexibility_need.

questions.parent_wording: What would greater flexibility make possible?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reduced to 8 (elementary/middle) or 10 (HS/undetermined) new-entry choices. ATHLETIC_TRAINING is now the new-entry umbrella for athletics/training/competition; COMPETITION and ATHLETIC_TRAVEL retired from new-entry use and aliased to it. WORK is the new-entry umbrella for work/entrepreneurship; BUSINESS retired and aliased to it. FAMILY_TIME retired from new-entry use (not aliased -- FAMILY_RESPONSIBILITIES/OTHER are not a safely equivalent meaning); historical FAMILY_TIME answers remain their own effective value. Added inline Other free-text elaboration.

questions.parent_wording: When would focused academic work fit best?
questions.matching_use: Preference only. Never translate preferred times into unavailable times.

questions.parent_wording: What sport or athletic activity is your student most involved in?
questions.matching_use: Optional; 60 characters maximum. Personalization/advisor context only. No educational scoring, no prestige weighting.

questions.parent_wording: Which best describes your student's current athletic experience?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: positive labels, no prestige framing (see labels.ts). Advisor context only. Not educational ability, family value, recruiting potential, or score multiplier. Never used to derive athletic_schedule_demand.

questions.parent_wording: About how much time does athletics usually require in a typical week?
questions.helper_text: Include training, practices, games or competitions.
questions.matching_use: Scheduling context, not automatic proof of missing school. Feeds derived athletic_schedule_demand.

questions.parent_wording: How often does athletics take your student away from home for training or competition?
questions.matching_use: Travel does not equal permission to attend a virtual public school from anywhere. Feeds derived athletic_schedule_demand.

questions.parent_wording: Is competing in college something your student may want to explore in the future?
questions.matching_use: Optional and future-oriented in middle grades. No implied division or eligibility. A DEFINITELY/POSSIBLY answer shows the formal follow-up question DISC_020A (ncaa_interest).

questions.parent_wording: Would it be helpful to include NCAA academic requirements in your student's planning?
questions.helper_text: We can help identify what should be reviewed; this does not determine NCAA eligibility.
questions.matching_use: show_when resolves to: DISC_020's branch (ATHLETICS_INTEREST_AND_MIDDLE_OR_HS) is active AND DISC_020 was answered DEFINITELY or POSSIBLY. Never shown for K-4. Do not infer NCAA interest from athletic participation alone; this question must be explicitly answered to produce ncaa_interest. An explicitly selected UNKNOWN is a recorded answer and may support review signal REV_NCAA (per rule ATH_004). A skipped, missing, or branch-inactive (hidden) question produces an effective value of NOT_APPLICABLE, not UNKNOWN.

questions.parent_wording: Would you like grade placement or reclassification to be part of your student's educational planning review?
questions.helper_text: This is an individualized academic planning question; selecting it does not mean a grade change is being recommended.
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Review only; never recommend repeating a grade or promise another eligibility year.

display_labels.POSSIBLY: Possibly -- we'd like to understand it better

questions.parent_wording: Which opportunities would you be interested in exploring for your student?
questions.helper_text: You don't need to know whether your student currently qualifies -- these are just possibilities to explore.
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reduced grade-tiered lists (K-4 ~5, middle ~10, HS ~11) since DISC_034 now owns subject-area detail and DISC_022 owns opportunity TYPE only. ADVANCED_MATH/ADVANCED_SCIENCE/ADVANCED_ELA retired from new-entry use and aliased to CHALLENGING_COURSEWORK (identical ADV_010 activation target, so no Phase-4-relevant distinction is lost). New canonical HONORS_AP ("Honors/AP") activates both OP02 and OP03 via new rule ADV_014 -- legacy HONORS-only/AP-only answers are NOT aliased to it and keep activating their own original single-opportunity rule (ADV_001/ADV_002), since they are more precise than the combined card. New canonical CAREER_CTE_CREDENTIALS ("Career/CTE or industry credentials", HIGH_SCHOOL tier only) activates both OP08 and OP09 via new rule ADV_015; MIDDLE tier keeps plain CAREER_CTE ("Career/technical exploration", grade-conditional label) since INDUSTRY_CREDENTIALS was never a MIDDLE-tier option. Added inline Other free-text elaboration; NONE_CURRENTLY stays exclusive.

questions.parent_wording: How does college fit into your student's plans right now?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording + one new explicit exploratory value (EXPLORING) rather than overloading UNKNOWN. College interest alone does not activate dual enrollment or advanced-course readiness. College not being in the plan has no negative recommendation consequence. Never shown for K-4.

display_labels.PROBABLY_NOT: Probably not part of the current plan
display_labels.NOT_CURRENTLY: Not part of the plan right now

questions.parent_wording: How clear is your student's path to graduation?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Parent-reported; not an audit/transcript conclusion. NO triggers graduation review, not an assertion that credits are missing.

display_labels.YES: On track based on what we know
display_labels.MOSTLY: Mostly on track, with a few things we may need to review
display_labels.NO: We may need help getting back on track

questions.parent_wording: Would reviewing or recovering credits be helpful as part of the plan?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Only YES/POSSIBLY activates credit-recovery exploration. Never automatically equated with online or alternative school. May coexist with advancement interest -- not mutually exclusive.

questions.parent_wording: When you picture the right educational fit, what matters most?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: helper sentence removed (max 3 still enforced by max_selections without needing the explanation); new-entry list reduced from 14-16 to 11-12 by retiring ATHLETIC_FLEXIBILITY and LOCATION_FLEXIBILITY (athletics/schedule questions already capture why flexibility matters), ADVANCED_COURSES (covered by ACADEMIC_ADVANCEMENT + later advancement questions), and ACCREDITATION/DIPLOMA (judged not necessary to preserve as a combined concept -- neither was reachable by any rule and scoring-policy.json already treats both as proving nothing about generic-model superiority). None of these five are aliased to any survivor -- they are simply retired, consistent with ACADEMIC_QUALITY's Phase 3E precedent. Added inline Other free-text elaboration.

questions.parent_wording: What role would you ideally like to have in your student's day-to-day learning?
questions.helper_text: Families support learning in different ways. We're interested in what would work best for yours.
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Desired involvement remains distinct from actual availability. PROGRAM_MANAGES does not mean no supervision exists. Feeds derived family_management_preference.

questions.parent_wording: What should we keep in mind about cost as we explore options?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only, and an architectural clarification: cost belongs to PRACTICAL FEASIBILITY, not educational fit (docs/pathways/DISCOVERY_CALIBRATION_SPEC_V2.md section 12) -- a Phase 4 evaluator must never treat a tuition-free preference as proof that a public-school category is a better educational fit (see DECISION_LOG DEC-H2; contracts/rules.json COST_001 retired accordingly). Preference, not budget ceiling or income. Never make a family less worthy of advice. Pathways fees disclosed separately.

questions.parent_wording: When would you like to begin putting the next step in place?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Operations only. Never educational scoring, never emotional-pressure logic. Excluded from educational facts/scoring inputs.

questions.parent_wording: Is there anything else you'd want a Pathways advisor to understand about your student or family's goals?
questions.helper_text: Optional. You don't need to repeat anything you've already shared. Please don't include medical records, Social Security numbers, student ID numbers, or other sensitive documents here.
questions.matching_use: Optional 750 characters; sanitized display. Advisor-only. Excluded from recommendation scoring, AI input, and analytics/pixels. The automated report never appears to have interpreted this text.

questions.parent_wording: Which foundations would you most like to strengthen?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording only. Do not repeat known support questions. NONE/UNKNOWN exclusive.

questions.parent_wording: If learning happens partly at home, who could be part of your student's daytime support?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording + narrowed branch (HOME_OR_REMOTE_SUPPORT_CONTEXT replaces the old ELEMENTARY_OR_HOME_BASED_INTEREST_WITH_SUPPORT_NEED, which incorrectly asked every elementary family regardless of whether home/remote learning was actually being considered). Person type does not prove capacity, teacher qualification, or sufficient supervision.

questions.parent_wording: How important is in-person learning with other students?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: reworded and helper removed; this question measures IN-PERSON PEER LEARNING PREFERENCE specifically (whether a fully remote/home pathway would need a deliberate in-person social/learning plan) -- it is not a general social-development or psychological measure, and must never be read or reported as one.

display_labels.SOMEWHAT: Important, but it doesn't need to happen every day

questions.parent_wording: If learning happens partly at home, how much daytime adult support could realistically be available?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording + narrowed branch (see DISC_E02). Availability, not willingness. No assumption of unattended learning being suitable.

questions.parent_wording: Which best describes what you're hoping for right now?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3F: card order fixed to STAY_CURRENT/SEEKING_CHANGE/OPEN_TO_CHANGE/UNKNOWN (owner-specified) and descriptive per-option helper text removed for a simpler screen; continuity semantics unchanged from Phase 3E.

questions.parent_wording: Are there times when regularly scheduled classes would be difficult to attend?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording + broadened branch (SCHEDULE_CONSTRAINT_CONTEXT replaces FLEXIBILITY_VERY_OR_ESSENTIAL-only: now also shown for SOMEWHAT flexibility, or when schedule-intensive context already exists -- athletics, travel, arts/performance, work). NONE/UNKNOWN exclusive; do not infer minimum-hours waivers.

display_labels.VARIES: It varies from week to week

questions.parent_wording: What learning opportunities are you open to exploring?
questions.helper_text: Choose any that feel worth considering. You don't need to know which is best yet.
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: new canonical OPEN_TO_RECOMMENDATIONS added -- distinct from UNKNOWN, and must never default to any model or receive an automatic scoring bonus (docs/pathways/DISCOVERY_CALIBRATION_SPEC_V2.md section 13). Distinguishes delivery interest from preferred activity.

questions.parent_wording: Are there subjects where your student would enjoy more challenge or depth?
questions.matching_use: Phase 3E: rewording + two new canonical values (ELA replaces the generic READING/WRITING pairing for older students; SOCIAL_STUDIES_HUMANITIES is new). Subject-specific advancement kept distinct from overall academic position; not demonstrated ability. K-4 continues age-appropriate subject wording via grade_band_allowed_values.

global_rules: Required means an answer may be UNKNOWN; do not force certainty.
NONE, UNKNOWN, EXPLORING and NONE_CURRENTLY are exclusive where specified.
Do not initialize a real answer by default.
Branch changes remove hidden answers from effective evaluation; preserve only necessary revision history under retention policy.
Do not claim a fixed question count or completion time before measuring actual branches.
Render friendly labels for enum values; technical values are never displayed.
Display name is optional and excluded from scoring and AI requests.
No transcripts, diagnoses, medical documents, full address, date of birth, Social Security number or NCAA identifier in Discovery.

An explicitly selected UNKNOWN is a recorded answer and may support a review signal where a rule documents that (e.g. DISC_020A -> REV_NCAA via ATH_004). A skipped, missing, or branch-inactive (hidden) question is never treated as an explicit UNKNOWN -- its effective value is NOT_APPLICABLE -- and must not satisfy any rule condition or trigger any signal. This applies to every question in this registry, not only DISC_020A.

Phase 3E: a legacy/retired enum value remains a valid, readable historical raw answer and is never rewritten in storage; it is normalized (aliased to its replacement, or dropped) only when computing EFFECTIVE answers (contracts/legacy-aliases.json question_value_aliases / question_value_removals), never when rendering a family's own Review screen.

Phase 3E: no mid-survey interpretive/reflective summary card exists anywhere in the Discovery flow (Questions -> adaptive questions -> Review -> Complete only); any future reflective synthesis belongs to the Phase 5 Discovery Report, not this questionnaire.
